answer_1.quote: We use GPT-3 to extract novel rules-of-thumb from unseen answers... using Chain-of-Thought prompting together with GPT-3 (text-davinci-003) to generate most of the data automatically.
answer_1.outputs: rule-of-thumb social norms, entailment relation labels (Entailment, Contradiction, No Relation), free-text explanations

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of model-generated explanations using the explanation score metric: an average of BLEURT and BERTScore... We report the macro average F1 score at three thresholds of the explanation score.

answer_4.quote: Three students with significant lived experiences (10+ years) in Chinese and American cultures assessed the quality of a subset of 50 randomly chosen model-generated explanations for correctly predicted labels, evaluating performance between the best performing model finetuned only on related tasks (T5-eSNLI) and the best-performing model that was directly fine-tuned on our dataset (T5-SocNorm).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rate which generated explanation they preferred, allowing for the presence of ties.
